_note: Disguises picked before a job. Each mission offers three, and which one works is decided by the mission's seed: one slips the band past a fight, one lets them strike first, one gets them spotted. {place} is the job's location.

potter.name: Potter
potter.wear: Robin buys a potter's cart, pots and all, and cries his wares at half price.
potter.slip: The guards are so busy haggling over cheap pots that the band rolls straight past them into {place}.
potter.surprise: While the guards squabble over a cracked jug, the band tips the cart over and charges!
potter.blown: A guard picks up a pot. 'This is a bucket with a hole in it!' He looks closer. 'And you're Robin Hood!'

beggar.name: Beggar
beggar.wear: The band puts on rags and patched cloaks, and Robin limps along on a crutch.
beggar.slip: Nobody looks twice at a crowd of beggars. The band shuffles right past the guards at {place}.
beggar.surprise: A guard tosses Robin a coin. Robin catches it, throws off his rags, and the beggars leap into action!
beggar.blown: A soldier kicks the crutch away, and Robin forgets to limp. 'That beggar runs like an outlaw!'

monk.name: Monks
monk.wear: The band borrows brown habits from a friendly abbey. Everyone pulls their hoods low and hums a hymn.
monk.slip: The guards bow their heads for the holy brothers, and the band walks solemnly past them at {place}.
monk.surprise: The 'monks' ask the guards to kneel for a blessing, and then the blessing turns into a scuffle!
monk.blown: One monk's habit is far too short, and his muddy boots stick out. 'Since when do monks carry longbows?'

butcher.name: Butcher
butcher.wear: Robin borrows a butcher's apron and cart and sells his meat so cheap the whole market crowds round.
butcher.slip: The guards are too busy buying sausages to notice the band slipping into {place}.
butcher.surprise: Robin hands out free sausages, and while the guards munch, the band jumps them!
butcher.blown: The real butcher storms up, red in the face. 'That's MY cart! Guards, seize that thief!'

tinker.name: Tinker
tinker.wear: Robin hangs pots and kettles off a pack and bangs his hammer, calling for things to mend.
tinker.slip: The guards wave the noisy tinker through just to be rid of the racket, and the band follows him into {place}.
tinker.surprise: Robin offers to mend a guard's helmet, then claps it down over his eyes. Now!
tinker.blown: Robin tries to mend a sergeant's kettle and knocks a hole right through it. 'You're no tinker!'

pilgrims.name: Pilgrims
pilgrims.wear: The band dresses as pilgrims on the road to the shrine, with scallop shells on their hats.
pilgrims.slip: The guards wish the pilgrims a safe journey, and the band strolls right through {place}.
pilgrims.surprise: The pilgrims stop to ask the way, and while the guards point down the road, the band pounces!
pilgrims.blown: A guard asks which shrine they're going to. Three outlaws answer at once, with three different shrines.

minstrels.name: Minstrels
minstrels.wear: Robin tunes a borrowed lute, and the band dresses in bright motley as travelling players.
minstrels.slip: The guards stop to listen to a merry song, and the rest of the band tiptoes past behind them at {place}.
minstrels.surprise: Robin plays a lullaby so sweet the guards start to nod, and the band springs!
minstrels.blown: The biggest outlaw is asked to sing. The guards cover their ears. 'No real minstrel sounds like that!'
